item.title: Ceasefire Hopes Trigger 15% TTF Crash — Biggest Down Day Since Hormuz Opened
item.description: Trump's 'very complete' crashed TTF 15% in a single session — the biggest down day since Hormuz opened — but mines are confirmed in the Strait and Iran's IRGC vows total blockade. The council validated 10 trades from 17, culling 7 redundant calendar spreads and vague cross-market plays; the JKM-TTF widener (unanimous) and Apr €50 straddle remain highest conviction, while the Apr/Oct calendar captures the ceasefire-vs-refill asymmetry.

item.title: TTF Holds €52 as Asian Demand Lifts JKM; HH Steady
item.description: Hormuz Week 2 with Qatar still dark and the April LNG ban six weeks away — the triple supply squeeze tightens. The council validated 10 trade ideas from 19, culling 9 duplicates and contradictions; the TTF Apr €55/€65 call spread and NBP-TTF locational play remain highest conviction, while the €48/€42 put is essential snap-back insurance.

item.title: TTF Steady at €52 Into Week 2 — Goldman Lifts Q2 Again as Hormuz Selective Blockade Hardens

item.title: TTF Retreats to €53 — Panic Premium Deflates 19% Off Spike

item.title: Day 2: Profit-Taking Pulls TTF Off €65 High — But €50 Holds
item.description: Day 3 of Hormuz with no diplomatic off-ramp: TTF pulled back to €53 from Monday's €65 panic spike, but the 30% storage floor just broke. The council validated 16 trade ideas out of 21 — the JKM-TTF parity spread and cheap Apr €65 calls stand out as the highest-conviction asymmetric plays. The refill math at €53+ TTF is brutal; this summer will test every assumption.
